description: Java class implementing a custom Optional type similar to Java 8's java.util.Optional and Guava's Optional, used within Apache Spark's Java API.

classes.name: Optional
classes.description: A serializable, re-implemented Optional class for Java 7 compatibility, providing methods to handle optional values without using Java 8 features.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an Optional containing a non-null value.

methods.name: ofNullable
methods.description: Creates an Optional that may or may not contain a non-null value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the contained value if present, throws NullPointerException if empty.

methods.name: orElse
methods.description: Returns the contained value if present, otherwise returns the provided default.

methods.name: isPresent
methods.description: Checks if the Optional contains a value.

methods.name: absent
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional (alias for empty).

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates an Optional from a nullable value (alias for ofNullable).

methods.name: or
methods.description: Returns the contained value if present, otherwise returns the provided alternative.

methods.name: orNull
methods.description: Returns the contained value if present, or null if empty.
